extension.label: Altioo MCP iTop Extension
extension.description: Turns this iTop into a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so an AI assistant can search, read and update CMDB and ticketing objects - never seeing or changing more than the authenticated user could through the console. Requires iTop 3.2 or 3.3 and PHP 8.2-8.4. Access is gated by a dedicated profile, by MCP-scoped tokens and by iTop's own permissions; every write is a dry run until the caller confirms it; every call is audited. iTop itself opens no outbound connection. AGPL-3.0-or-later. See the documentation link for setup, configuration and security notes.
